Market Update · November 2026

The Market Is Giving Buyers Time Again

Across central Denver, we're seeing more price reductions, more homes to choose from, and a little more anxiety on both sides of the table. Buyers are taking their time and looking for value. Sellers who list now usually have a real reason to move, and the ones who price it right from day one are still selling.

Active Listings
12,978, up 3.9% from a year ago
Closings
2,748, down 23.5% from a year ago
Seller Concessions
65% of sales, averaging $12,557
Median Days on Market
30

Denver metro, October 2026. Source: DMAR Market Trends Report, October 2026 data.

About Chris

A Decade in Real Estate, a Lifetime in Colorado

I've spent ten years in the real estate industry, starting with RE/MAX in 2016. Today I'm a Broker Associate on The Real Estate Experts team at RE/MAX Professionals, helping families buy and sell across central Denver.

Real estate runs in my family. I grew up in Breckenridge, where my parents ran a property management business and my father held his real estate license. Clients tell me I'm patient and I explain everything, and I give honest advice even when it isn't what you want to hear.

Off the clock, I'm with my family, on the ski hill, on the water, or watching soccer. More about me.
